_about: Every docs screenshot shoot.mjs takes. name = the scenario step that takes it; file is relative to docs/images (default guide/<name>.png); page = the docs page that shows it; selector = what must be on screen (scrolled into view, block 'nearest' unless given; scroll false = leave the page as it is). Every shot is the full 1440x900 viewport, light theme. Page tasks add entries here and a matching shoot("<name>") call in shoot.mjs.
